SectionC:Crime,devianceandsocialcontrol

text: There are several reasons why different social groups do better than others in education. Some
believe this is due to the peer group, whereas others refer to school factors such as the self-
fulfilling prophecy and the hidden curriculum. Whether the education system today offers students
equality of opportunity remains a matter of debate.

SectionD:Media

text: Official crime statistics are one way of measuring crime rates. This helps the Government to
decide on effective punishments to control crime levels in society. However, they do not account
for the dark figure of crime and so their accuracy can be questioned.

text: The media are thought to be a very powerful agency of socialisation that can affect the audience’s
attitudes and behaviour. The traditional media have been accused of creating and reinforcing
stereotypical representations, but many believe that these are now beginning to change.
